summary_en: Five years after its initial release, Marvel's Guardians of the Galaxy has resurfaced with a surprise "Encore Edition" announced for the Nintendo Switch 2. This unexpected move has reignited fan passion, with many now clamoring for a follow-up adventure.

en.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Game Surprise Switch 2 Port Sparks Sequel Hopes
en.summary: Five years after its initial release, Marvel's Guardians of the Galaxy has resurfaced with a surprise "Encore Edition" announced for the Nintendo Switch 2. This unexpected move has reignited fan passion, with many now clamoring for a follow-up adventure.
en.body:
After its initial launch in 2021, **Marvel's Guardians of the Galaxy** seemed destined to be a standalone gem, praised for its engaging story and characters but falling short of sales expectations. Developed by **Eidos Montreal**, the game captured the chaotic charm of Star-Lord, Gamora, Drax, Rocket, and Groot with a narrative that felt distinctly *Guardians*. Despite its critical success, its commercial performance led many to believe a sequel was unlikely, leaving fans to cherish the single adventure they had.

However, the gaming landscape can be full of surprises. During a recent Nintendo Direct presentation, a new "Encore Edition" of **Marvel's Guardians of the Galaxy** was revealed, exclusively for the upcoming **Nintendo Switch 2**. This port isn't just a simple re-release; it promises enhanced graphics and new content, including fresh outfits for the beloved cosmic misfits. The sudden reappearance of the game, especially on new hardware, has caught many off guard, sparking renewed discussion and excitement within the community.

## The Cosmic Comeback

The announcement of the **Nintendo Switch 2** version has undeniably breathed new life into the **Guardians of the Galaxy** game. It's a second chance for the title to reach a wider audience and, more importantly, to demonstrate its enduring appeal. The fact that a new edition is being developed and released, even with the game having missed its initial sales targets, suggests a belief in its quality and potential. This move could serve as a crucial test for the market, gauging how much demand exists for more adventures with this particular iteration of the Guardians.

## Fans Demand a Sequel

As expected, the surprise announcement has sent ripples through social media. Fans who adored the original game are ecstatic, urging new players not to overlook this "fking dope" title. More significantly, the comments sections on official Marvel Games and **Eidos Montreal** channels are flooded with fervent pleas for a sequel. "Can we just get a sequel? The people have been asking for years," and "**Marvel's Guardians of the Galaxy 2**, please," are just some of the sentiments echoing across platforms. This outpouring of support highlights a passionate fanbase eager to continue the journey with Star-Lord and his crew, making a compelling case for **Marvel** and **Eidos Montreal** to consider further installments.

## What's Next

While no official release date has been confirmed for the **Marvel's Guardians of the Galaxy: Encore Edition** on **Nintendo Switch 2**, industry observers have noted age ratings appearing in certain regions, suggesting an imminent launch. Fans eagerly await further details regarding the exact release window and the full scope of new content. The success of this port could very well pave the way for a highly anticipated sequel.

content_raw: Marvel's Guardians of the Galaxy has re-emerged, five years after its release, with a new Switch 2 version... and some fans hope it could lead to a sequel. During today's Nintendo Direct, fans were surprised to learn that Eidos Montreal's Guardians of the Galaxy game is coming back. It's getting a new "Encore Edition," exclusive to Nintendo Switch 2, which not only brings the game to a new platform, but also adds new content like special outfits for the cosmic heroes. This news came as a bit of a shock, since the game missed sales expectations despite having great reviews , so fans assumed that we'd never see this iteration of the Guardians ever again. Now, this new release has some hoping that the Guardians may live on. Over on social media, excited fans are pleading to Marvel and Eidos Montreal to produce a sequel. Maybe a Switch 2 version could be used to test the waters, but it's hard to say. Either way, it's great to see such a beloved game finding its way back into the market, and hopefully, it can create some demand for another entry in the series. "Don’t sleep on this game, Switch players. It’s fu**ing dope," said one fan . "Do yourself a favor and pick this up! It’s a GREAT game! I hate the fact that this gem got overlooked (and Midnight Suns as well btw)," noted another . "Can we just get a sequel? The people have been asking for years," asked another fan . "Marvel's Guardians of the Galaxy 2, please," another pleaded . These are far from the only people asking for a sequel or begging new players to check it out; the comments under the announcement posts from Marvel Games and the game's official account are flooded with similar responses. Guardians of the Galaxy has seemingly had legs over the years. A year after its release, the team behind the game announced it had reached 8 million players, partially thanks to the game's inclusion on services like Xbox Game Pass. It's unclear how many people have played it since then, but it's frequently deeply discounted, so the numbers have likely only grown a fair bit in the last four years. Eidos Montreal also stated that it had no regrets over the game , despite it not being a big seller. Marvel's Guardians of the Galaxy: Encore Edition will hit Nintendo Switch 2 on November 5. Whether it gets overshadowed by the remake of The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remains to be seen, but hopefully it can find a new audience on the platform.
